orbitSensitivity.title: Orbit Sensitivity
orbitSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves around the orbit. Higher is faster

distanceSensitivity.title: Distance Sensitivity
distanceSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves in and out. Higher is faster

orbitSensitivity.title: Orbit Sensitivity
orbitSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves around the orbit. Higher is faster

distanceSensitivity.title: Distance Sensitivity
distanceSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves in and out. Higher is faster

bands.title: Color Bands
bands.description: Number of shading steps. Lower is flatter.

glossThreshold.title: Gloss Threshold
glossThreshold.description: Higher values create a tighter, sharper highlight.

sourceMesh.title: Source Mesh (Template)
sourceMesh.description: Drag one of the leaf objects here to use as the mesh source.

groupSize.title: Group Size
groupSize.description: Number of leaves per clump. Leaves 0-3 = group 1, 4-7 = group 2, etc.

forwardNode.title: Forward Node
forwardNode.description: Optional child whose facing defines forward

minDistance.title: Min Distance
minDistance.description: Closest camera can zoom in to avoid clipping

pivotOffset.title: Pivot Offset
pivotOffset.description: Local-space offset used for zoom/pivot/look-at (set Y to center mass).

minPitch.title: Min Pitch (deg)
minPitch.description: Lowest pitch angle (looking down). Prevents top-down camera.

homeWallMargin.title: Home Wall Margin
homeWallMargin.description: How far (m) the camera stays off the walls of your own home while you are inside it.

homeComfortDistance.title: Home Comfort Distance
homeComfortDistance.description: In a tight room the camera rises to look down more (as far as Min Pitch) until it can stand at least this far back.

homeMinDistance.title: Home Min Distance
homeMinDistance.description: Closest the camera comes in a home, even with a wall right behind you.

homeWallPitch.title: Home Wall Pitch (deg)
homeWallPitch.description: When a wall of your own home is in the way, the camera is at least this high: it rises and looks down at the player instead of sinking to the floor and looking up.

maxAngle.description: Maximum angle in degrees for random rotation on each axis

shakeDuration.description: Duration of the shake motion in seconds

shakeDistance.description: Maximum distance for the up-down shake

everyFrameDistance.title: Every-Frame Distance
everyFrameDistance.description: Closer than this the label turns every frame. Further away it turns every 4th frame, and beyond twice this distance every 8th: there are dozens of these labels and far ones are tiny on screen.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Colyseus endpoint. Leave empty to derive ws(s):// from the current page host.

snowAreas.title: Snow Areas
snowAreas.description: Trigger collider entities that enable snow and fog for the local player.

snowExitGrace.title: Snow Exit Grace
snowExitGrace.description: Seconds to wait for player/car collider handoffs before leaving snow weather.

closedFaceSpriteAsset.title: Closed Face Sprite
closedFaceSpriteAsset.description: Optional. Falls back to the FacesSpriteClosed sprite asset.

luminaText.title: Lumina Text
luminaText.description: HUD label for the Lumina balance. Falls back to an entity named LuminaText/Lumina when empty.

mobileMaxPixelRatio.title: Mobile Max Pixel Ratio
mobileMaxPixelRatio.description: Ceiling on the backbuffer scale for phones and tablets. Cost is the square of this number: a phone reporting 2.8125 renders about eight times the pixels of a 1:1 backbuffer, which is what pins low-end GPUs into single-digit FPS. 1 draws one backbuffer pixel per CSS pixel.

desktopMaxPixelRatio.title: Desktop Max Pixel Ratio
desktopMaxPixelRatio.description: Ceiling for desktop, which normally has GPU headroom to spare. Retina displays report 2, so 2 keeps them sharp.

firstTimeSpawnPoint.title: First Time Spawn Point
firstTimeSpawnPoint.description: Where a player starts before they have finished the movement tutorial, so their first walk to a chest is short. Leave this empty to start them exactly where PlayerEntity sits in the editor. Players who have finished the tutorial always use Spawn Point.

firstTimeLookTarget.title: First Time Look Target
firstTimeLookTarget.description: Entity the player turns to face when they spawn for the first time, before the movement tutorial is finished. Aiming at a target is used instead of an angle because the character controller overwrites the model rotation on its first frame, so any yaw authored on PlayerEntity is gone before it can be read. Leave empty to keep whatever facing the character starts with.

maxRenderMegapixels.title: Max Render Megapixels
maxRenderMegapixels.description: Budget on how many pixels the backbuffer may hold, in millions, whatever pixel ratio that works out to. A flat ratio cannot know how big the window is: 2x is 6.3MP on a 13-inch laptop and 33MP on a 4K monitor. 0 disables the budget and leaves only the ratio ceilings.

moneyFxCount.title: Money Fx Count
moneyFxCount.description: Pieces of money a collect pops out (a bigger payout adds a few, up to Money Fx Max).

moneyFxScale.title: Money Fx Scale
moneyFxScale.description: Size of each piece, times the MoneyTemplate.

moneyFxCollectInterval.title: Money Fx Collect Gap
moneyFxCollectInterval.description: All pieces pop out together and wait on the ground; they leave for the player two at a time, in a random order, this many seconds apart.

shopDesktopFramingOffset.title: Desktop Player Left Offset
shopDesktopFramingOffset.description: Horizontal framing as a fraction of camera distance. Larger values move the player farther left.

shopDesktopAvailableWidth.title: Desktop Available Screen Width
shopDesktopAvailableWidth.description: Fallback fraction of the screen left of SkinShopUI2. The live UI panel edge is used when available.

shopMobileFramingOffset.title: Mobile Player Top Offset
shopMobileFramingOffset.description: Vertical framing as a fraction of camera distance. Larger values move the player farther up.

shopMobileShoeCameraLift.title: Mobile Shoe Camera Lift
shopMobileShoeCameraLift.description: Raises the shoe-detail camera by this fraction of player height while it looks down at the feet.

shopMobileShoeBottomMargin.title: Mobile Shoe Bottom Margin
shopMobileShoeBottomMargin.description: Reserves visible ground below the shoes as a fraction of player height.

shopPortraitAspectThreshold.title: Portrait Layout Aspect Threshold
shopPortraitAspectThreshold.description: Width divided by height below which the shop uses its portrait layout. The landscape panel is a fixed width, so in a narrow window it covers the player; portrait keeps the player above it instead. 0 restores the old rule of portrait only when taller than wide.

shopHandCameraDistance.title: Shop Hand Camera Distance
shopHandCameraDistance.description: Hand section: camera distance for a held item (a balloon steps back a little more to keep it in the shot).

move.title: Move XYZ
move.description: Local movement speed in units per second.

rotate.title: Rotate XYZ
rotate.description: Local rotation speed in degrees per second.

tweenPosition.title: Tween Position XYZ
tweenPosition.description: Position to tween to. Relative if Tween Relative is enabled.

tweenRotation.title: Tween Rotation XYZ
tweenRotation.description: Euler rotation to tween to. Relative if Tween Relative is enabled.

tweenEase.title: Tween Ease
tweenEase.description: Linear, SineInOut, SineIn, SineOut, QuadInOut, BackOut.

milestoneSeconds.title: Milestone Seconds
milestoneSeconds.description: How long a "step complete" line holds the text bar before the next objective replaces it.

hintDelaySeconds.title: Hint Delay Seconds
hintDelaySeconds.description: Seconds on one step before the bar starts offering that step's hint.

completeSeconds.title: Complete Seconds
completeSeconds.description: How long the Complete badge stays up before the tutorial closes itself.

chestArrow.title: Chest Arrow
chestArrow.description: Root/TutorialChestArrow. Bobs over the free chest until it is opened, so nobody walks past it.

chestArrowHeight.title: Chest Arrow Height
chestArrowHeight.description: Metres above the chest the arrow floats.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A unique name for the button to refer to it by in the API. Will give a warning in browser tools if the name is not unique.

vibration.title: Vibration duration (ms)
vibration.description: If the device supports vibration with 'Navigator.vibrate', it will vibrate for the duration set here on touch down.Set to 0 to disable.

baseEntity.title: Base Entity
baseEntity.description: Image Element Entity that shows the base of the joystick.

nubEntity.title: Nub Entity
nubEntity.description: Image Element Entity that shows the nub (top) of the joystick.

order: Move to first touch and fixed
Move to first touch and drags

type.title: Type
type.description: Set type of behavior for the joystick.

hideOnRelease.title: Hide on Release
hideOnRelease.description: Will only show the joystick when the user is using it and will hide it on touch end. This is commonly used if you don't want the joystick to block what's being shown on screen.

identifier.title: Idenitifier
identifier.description: A unique name for the joystick to refer to it by in the API. Joysticks are also buttons so this will also be the name of button in the API. It will give a warning in browser tools if the name is not unique.

axisDeadZone.title: Axis Dead Zone
axisDeadZone.description: The number of UI units from the position of the Base Entity where input is not registered.

axisRange.title: Axis Range
axisRange.description: The number of UI units from the position of the Base Entity that the Nub Entity can move to and is the maximum range

positionOnRelease.title: Position on Release
positionOnRelease.description: Where to move the joystick on release and can help keep the screen tidy so that there are clear areas to show the game and arrange controls.

vibrationPress.title: Vibration duration (ms)
vibrationPress.description: If the device supports vibration with 'Navigator.vibrate', it will vibrate for the duration set here on touch down.Set to 0 to disable.

driverScale.title: Driver Scale
driverScale.description: World-scale multiplier applied to the player while seated. The original scale is restored on exit.

shiftSpeedMultiplier.title: Shift Speed Multiplier
shiftSpeedMultiplier.description: Top speed while Shift is held, times Max Speed.

shiftAccelerationMultiplier.title: Shift Acceleration Multiplier
shiftAccelerationMultiplier.description: Acceleration while Shift is held, times Acceleration.

groundIgnoreTags.title: Ground Ignore Tags
groundIgnoreTags.description: Comma-separated tags the car ground ray ignores. Add one of these to death zones or invisible triggers.

noClimbTags.title: No Climb Tags
noClimbTags.description: Comma-separated tags the car should not snap/climb onto. Add one to homes, roofs, walls, or props.

exitLift.title: Exit Lift
exitLift.description: Extra height the driver is dropped in at when getting out, so they settle onto the ground instead of starting inside it.

vehicleType.title: Vehicle Type
vehicleType.description: Bicycle: the rider plays RidingBicycle (Bike_idle/Bike_ride) instead of Driving, and Bicycle.js turns the wheels, handlebar and cranks and leans the frame.

bikeTurnLean.title: Bike Turn Lean
bikeTurnLean.description: Bicycle only: degrees the bike and rider lean into a turn at full steer (reached at 4 m/s).

bikeHandlebarTurn.title: Bike Handlebar Turn
bikeHandlebarTurn.description: Bicycle only: degrees the handlebar turns at full steer.

shiftAnimSpeed.title: Shift Pedal Speed
shiftAnimSpeed.description: Bicycle only: how much faster the rider pedals at full Shift speed than at normal top speed.

spawnPoint.title: Spawn Point
spawnPoint.description: Optional override. Falls back to GameManager.spawnPoint, then SpawnPoint in the scene.

openOnTouch.title: Open On Touch
openOnTouch.description: Walking into this entity opens the Index. Off at the homes, whose circle buys floors now.

cameraEntity.title: Camera
cameraEntity.description: Optional. Used for fresnel and specular highlights. If empty, the first enabled camera is used.

waveHeight.title: Wave Height
waveHeight.description: Requires enough mesh subdivisions to be visible as geometry.

shoreFoamRadius.title: Shore Foam Radius
shoreFoamRadius.description: UV radius for the island-style foam ring. Set Shore Foam Strength to 0 to disable it.

edgeFoamWidth.title: Edge Foam Width
edgeFoamWidth.description: Foam near the outside UV borders of the water mesh.

target.title: Distance Target
target.description: Entity to measure distance from. Falls back to the active camera.

hysteresis.title: Hysteresis
hysteresis.description: Distance inside the cull boundary required before an entity is enabled again.

checkInterval.title: Check Interval
checkInterval.description: Every tagged entity is checked once per interval; the checks are spread across the frames in between.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: Pause between scans for newly tagged entities.

scanNodesPerFrame.title: Scan Nodes Per Frame
scanNodesPerFrame.description: How many scene nodes the tag scan visits per frame. The scene has thousands of nodes, so a whole scan in one frame caused a hitch.

labelCullTag.title: Label Cull Tag
labelCullTag.description: World-space labels with this tag hide their text and images beyond Label Cull Distance. Only the element components are switched, so game code that shows or hides the label entity keeps working.

coolColor.title: Cool Color
coolColor.description: Color used around the cooler, broken-up parts of the flame.

hotColor.title: Hot Color
hotColor.description: Bright color used near the base and inside the flame.

sway.title: Sway
sway.description: Side-to-side movement as a fraction of the cone height.

additive.title: Additive Glow
additive.description: Enable for a softer, brighter flame. Normal blending keeps the colors richer.

sourceMesh.title: Source Leaf
sourceMesh.description: A single leaf entity with a Render or Model component. Attach this script to the parent that contains all placement markers.

includeDescendants.title: Recursive Markers
includeDescendants.description: Disabled: direct children are markers. Enabled: renderable, tagged, or leaf-node descendants are markers.

markerTag.title: Marker Tag
markerTag.description: Optional entity tag used to select placement markers. Leave empty to use the container children.

includeSource.title: Include Source As Marker
includeSource.description: When the source leaf is inside this container, also render an instance at its transform.

hideMarkers.title: Hide Marker Renders
hideMarkers.description: Hides the original marker Render / Model components so only the GPU-instanced leaves are drawn.

hideSource.title: Hide Source In Field
hideSource.description: Hides the source Render / Model when the source entity is inside this foliage container.

chunkSize.title: Chunk Size
chunkSize.description: World-space XZ size per instanced draw. Use 0 for a single draw; 12-32 is recommended for large terrain.

frustumCulling.title: Chunk Culling
frustumCulling.description: Cull each spatial chunk using a calculated, wind-expanded bounding box.

autoRebuildInterval.title: Transform Check Interval
autoRebuildInterval.description: 0 keeps the field static. A positive value checks marker transforms and rebuilds changed instance buffers at this interval.

windStrength.title: Wind Strength
windStrength.description: Maximum left/right tip travel as a fraction of the leaf length.

flutter.title: Flutter
flutter.description: Adds a smaller secondary wave so the motion does not look mechanical.

bendExponent.title: Bend Falloff
bendExponent.description: Higher values keep more of the leaf rigid near its root.

rootAtMinimum.title: Root At Minimum
rootAtMinimum.description: Disable when the root is at the positive end of the Root To Tip Axis.

useVertexColorMask.title: Use Vertex Color Mask
useVertexColorMask.description: Uses the red channel when it contains a gradient; otherwise the script automatically uses mesh position.

phaseVariation.title: Phase Variation
phaseVariation.description: 0 makes every instance sway together; 1 gives every placement a stable phase derived from its transform.

version.title: Format Version
version.description: Placement data format. Version 1 stores field-local TRS records.

chunkX.title: Chunk X
chunkX.description: Integer X coordinate of this spatial foliage chunk.

chunkZ.title: Chunk Z
chunkZ.description: Integer Z coordinate of this spatial foliage chunk.

pathData.title: Path Data
pathData.description: Terrain-projected ribbon data written by the Dirt Path editor brush.

materialAsset.title: Dirt Material
materialAsset.description: Material cloned for the generated dirt ribbon. A brown fallback is used when empty.

groundEntity.title: Editor Ground
groundEntity.description: Terrain collider root used by the editor brush. It is not used at runtime.

uvMeters.title: Texture Length (m)
uvMeters.description: World-space path length covered by one vertical texture repeat.

surfaceOffset.title: Surface Offset
surfaceOffset.description: Moves the ribbon along its saved normals to prevent z-fighting.

softEdges.title: Soft Edges
softEdges.description: Uses vertex opacity to feather both sides and the ends of each path section.

fallbackColor.title: Fallback Color
fallbackColor.description: Used until a Dirt Material is assigned and loaded.

headBone.title: Look Origin Bone
headBone.description: Face-position reference. Bone.002 can remain here even though it has no vertex weights.

turnSpeed.title: Turn Speed
turnSpeed.description: Tracking responsiveness. Set to 0 for immediate rotation.

playerOffset.title: Player Target Offset
playerOffset.description: World-space offset used when the player has no CameraFocus child.

deformBone.title: Head Deform Bone
deformBone.description: The bone weighted to the head mesh. Bone.001 for this Pinguin rig.

yawHysteresis.title: Yaw Re-entry Margin
yawHysteresis.description: After leaving Max Yaw, the player must return this many degrees inside the limit before tracking resumes.

eyeMaterialAsset.title: Eye Material Asset
eyeMaterialAsset.description: Optional. If empty, Eye Material Name is loaded at runtime.

eyeTextureAsset.title: Eye Texture Asset
eyeTextureAsset.description: Optional. If empty, Eye Texture Name is loaded at runtime.

trackDistance.title: Track Distance
trackDistance.description: The head follows the player only within this distance. Further away it settles back to the animation and costs nothing per frame. 0 means no limit.

autoAddHeadTracker.title: Auto Add Head Tracker
autoAddHeadTracker.description: Adds pinguinHeadTracker to this entity at runtime when it is not already attached.

babyId.title: Baby ID
babyId.description: Which baby this is: baby1, baby2 or baby3 (see PINGUIN_SERVER_IDS). Builds give entities new ids, so leave it set.

pickupGroup.title: Pickup Group
pickupGroup.description: Optional shared pickup prompt. Defaults to GameUI/PickupGroup.

pickupTargetName.title: Pickup Target Name
pickupTargetName.description: Optional child used by followWorldTarget. The baby entity is used when it is missing.

rescuePlaceName.title: Rescue Place Name
rescuePlaceName.description: Children under Mama Pinguin with this name are used as ordered rescued-baby slots.

typewriterSpeed.title: Characters Per Second
typewriterSpeed.description: Set to 0 to show each page immediately.

dialogueId.title: Dialogue ID
dialogueId.description: Optional stable save ID. Entity GUID is used when empty.

reapplyCompletionMethodOnLoad.title: Repeat Method On Load
reapplyCompletionMethodOnLoad.description: Enable only for idempotent methods such as removeBarrier.

useTriggerCollider.title: Use Trigger Collider
useTriggerCollider.description: Uses this entity collision trigger for interaction range. Falls back to Interact Radius when no collision component exists.

npcAnimationEntity.title: NPC Animation Entity
npcAnimationEntity.description: Optional. Uses this dialogue entity or its first child Anim component when empty.

talkAnimationTrigger.title: Talk Animation Trigger
talkAnimationTrigger.description: Anim State Graph trigger fired once when this dialogue starts. Leave empty to disable.

dialogueCameraDiagonal.title: Diagonal Offset
dialogueCameraDiagonal.description: Positive values place the camera farther behind the player.

dialogueCameraNpcLookBias.title: Look Toward NPC
dialogueCameraNpcLookBias.description: 0.5 looks at the midpoint; 1 looks directly at the NPC.

playerStandPoint.title: Player Stand Point
playerStandPoint.description: Where the player is placed when this conversation starts. Put an empty entity on the ground in front of the NPC, facing does not matter -- the player is always turned to look at the NPC. This is the only way to guarantee the player ends up in front rather than behind, because an NPC has no readable facing: the rotation is baked into the imported model and the Origin and Transform children are identity. Leave empty to keep the side the player walked up from and only correct their distance.

playerStandDistance.title: Player Stand Distance
playerStandDistance.description: How far from the NPC the player is placed when no Player Stand Point is assigned.

dialogueEntity.title: Dialogue Entity
dialogueEntity.description: Entity containing the dialogue script. Uses this entity when empty.

routerId.title: Router ID
routerId.description: Stable persistence ID. The router entity GUID is used when empty.

schema.name: pagesJson
schema.description: Optional JSON page array for multi-page dialogue. Overrides the single-page fields.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Optional local fallback. The server catalog is authoritative.

templateName.title: Visual Template Name
templateName.description: Optional extra lookup name for cloning this showroom visual.

pricePreview.title: Price Preview
pricePreview.description: Shown until the server catalog arrives. It does not control the purchase price.

pickupTarget.title: UI Target
pickupTarget.description: Optional. A PickupTarget child is created automatically when empty.

visualRoot.title: Furniture Visual
visualRoot.description: The permanent showroom visual used as a source for carried and placed copies.

target.title: Distance Target
target.description: Entity to measure distance from. Falls back to the active camera.

unloadTag.title: Unload Tag
unloadTag.description: Add this tag to a root entity. Textures used by that root and its descendants become streamable.

hysteresis.title: Hysteresis
hysteresis.description: How much closer the target must move before unloaded textures are loaded again.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often texture ownership is rescanned for new or changed entities.

restoreOnDestroy.title: Restore On Destroy
restoreOnDestroy.description: Reload textures unloaded by this script if the script is removed or destroyed.

scanInterval.title: Scan Interval
scanInterval.description: Seconds between proximity scans. Use 0 to scan once per frame.

flakeTexture.title: Flake Texture
flakeTexture.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a tiny procedural soft-circle texture.

preWarm.title: Pre-warm
preWarm.description: Starts with the snow volume already filled. Disable to reduce the one-time startup work.

gridColumns.title: Grid Columns
gridColumns.description: Authoritative home grids use 32 columns for fine furniture alignment.

gridRows.title: Grid Rows
gridRows.description: Authoritative home grids use 32 rows for fine furniture alignment.

cellSize.title: Legacy Cell Size
cellSize.description: Physical size used by the 8x8 fallback floor. The 32x32 snap cells are one quarter this size.

gridOriginName.title: Grid Origin Name
gridOriginName.description: Optional child entity on each HomeBase that defines the center and rotation of its grid.

editCameraHeightOffset.title: Edit Camera Height Offset
editCameraHeightOffset.description: Extra height above the doorway-aligned edit camera.

selectedTextureBox.title: Selected Furniture Box
selectedTextureBox.description: World-space sliced image placed below the active furniture footprint.

selectionBoxYOffset.title: Selection Box Y Offset
selectionBoxYOffset.description: Height above the grid floor; kept below the furniture and grid lines.

wallSnapInset.title: Wall Snap Inset
wallSnapInset.description: Small clearance retained when furniture in an outer cell is aligned to the floor edge.

gridWorldWidth.title: Grid Width Override
gridWorldWidth.description: Optional physical grid width. Leave at 0 to measure the interior floor automatically.

gridWorldDepth.title: Grid Depth Override
gridWorldDepth.description: Optional physical grid depth. Leave at 0 to measure the interior floor automatically.

gridEdgeInset.title: Grid Edge Inset
gridEdgeInset.description: Shrinks the measured floor boundary. The grid is never expanded beyond the house floor.

tabletopClearance.title: Tabletop Clearance
tabletopClearance.description: Small vertical gap between a surface and a small item placed on it.

wallMountCenterHeight.title: Wall Mount Center Height
wallMountCenterHeight.description: Height of the rendered center of wall-tagged furniture above its home floor.

rugYOffset.title: Rug Y Offset
rugYOffset.description: Extra height above the floor for rug-tagged furniture to prevent clipping and z-fighting.

dragHoldDuration.title: Furniture Drag Hold Time
dragHoldDuration.description: Seconds a touch must stay on furniture before it begins dragging.

wallHeightStepSize.title: Wall Height Step
wallHeightStepSize.description: Vertical distance moved by Z/X or the height buttons for wall-tagged furniture.

clickToPlace.title: Click To Place (mouse)
clickToPlace.description: Furniture follows the mouse as soon as it is picked, and a left click puts it down. Touch input keeps the tap-then-Place flow either way.

editCameraPitch.title: Edit Camera Pitch (deg)
editCameraPitch.description: Downward tilt applied when design mode frames the middle of the home.

tutorialEntryNudge.title: Tutorial Entry Nudge
tutorialEntryNudge.description: How far the first-home tutorial steps the player in from the doorway when decorating opens.

roomViewPitch.title: Room View Pitch (deg)
roomViewPitch.description: Downward tilt of the locked overhead camera that frames the whole room while decorating.

roomViewWallHeight.title: Room View Wall Height
roomViewWallHeight.description: How much of the back wall, in metres above the floor, the room view keeps on screen.

roomViewLerpSpeed.title: Room View Lerp Speed
roomViewLerpSpeed.description: How quickly the camera glides into and out of the room view.

roomBlackout.title: Room Blackout
roomBlackout.description: Inside-out box (Root/DecorateBlackout) wrapped around the home while decorating, so only the room stays visible.

roomBlackoutMargin.title: Room Blackout Margin
roomBlackoutMargin.description: Gap between the room edge and the blackout box. Must be wider than the walls so the walls stay inside it.

selectionBoxHoverColor.title: Hover Box Color
selectionBoxHoverColor.description: Footprint shown under placed furniture while the mouse is over it, so players can see what a click will pick up.

rotateViewButton.title: Rotate View Button
rotateViewButton.description: Turns the decorating room view a quarter turn, so another wall faces the camera. Found by name (RotateViewButton) when left empty.

holdToMoveSeconds.title: Hold To Move Time
holdToMoveSeconds.description: Seconds a finger must rest on a piece in your own home, outside Decorate, to open Decorate with that piece picked up.

dropHeight.title: Drop Height
dropHeight.description: A placed piece falls into place from this far above its spot. 0 turns the drop off.

dropGravity.title: Drop Gravity
dropGravity.description: How fast it falls, in m/s². Higher is snappier than real gravity (9.8).

dropBounce.title: Drop Bounce
dropBounce.description: Share of the landing speed it bounces back up with.

dropSquash.title: Drop Squash
dropSquash.description: How much it squashes on landing (0.16 = 16% flatter for a moment).

focusDistance.title: Focus Distance
focusDistance.description: Distance from the camera, in world units, that stays sharp.

focusRange.title: Focus Range
focusRange.description: Width of the sharp band and the transition into full blur.

maxBlurPixels.title: Max Blur (px)
maxBlurPixels.description: Maximum sampling radius in screen pixels.

nearBlur.title: Near Blur
nearBlur.description: Also blur objects closer than the focused band.

faceEntity.title: Face Entity
faceEntity.description: Optional. When empty, the script finds a child named Face.

faceOffset.title: Face Offset
faceOffset.description: Atlas offset for this NPC face. The same offset is kept while blinking.

closedFaceSpriteAsset.title: Closed Face Sprite
closedFaceSpriteAsset.description: Optional. When empty, FacesSpriteClosed is loaded by name.

uiRoot.title: Drone UI
uiRoot.description: Screen entity holding the Horizontal and Vertical delivery layouts. Falls back to an entity named DroneUI.

triggerEntity.title: Drone Trigger
triggerEntity.description: Entity whose trigger collision opens the panel. Falls back to an entity named DroneGroup.

cargoCapacity.title: Cargo Capacity
cargoCapacity.description: Maximum number of distinct item stacks the drone carries per delivery. 0 derives the capacity from the cargo slot grid.

closeDistance.title: Close Distance
closeDistance.description: Distance at which the panel closes when a trigger leave event is missed, for example after a respawn. 0 derives it from the collision radius.

droneEntity.title: Drone Model
droneEntity.description: Entity flown away on a delivery. Falls back to an entity named DroneAtlas under the trigger.

flightAscendDuration.title: Flight Ascend Time
flightAscendDuration.description: Straight climb after the curve, reading as the cargo being deployed.

flightRadius.title: Flight Curve Radius
flightRadius.description: How far the drone swings sideways on its way out.

flightWobble.title: Flight Wobble
flightWobble.description: Amplitude of the random drift layered over the flight path.

flightSpin.title: Flight Spin
flightSpin.description: Degrees of yaw across the whole flight. Keep it a multiple of 360 so the drone lands facing its authored direction.

carshopUi.title: Carshop UI
carshopUi.description: Panel root toggled on open/close. Required.

dealerEntity.title: Dealer Entity
dealerEntity.description: Position used for the purchase distance check. Defaults to this entity.

itemList.title: Item List
itemList.description: Parent of the car tiles. Falls back to a descendant named ItemList.

closeButton.title: Close Button
closeButton.description: Falls back to a descendant named CloseButton.

carIds.title: Car Ids
carIds.description: Catalog id for each tile, in tile order.

luminaIcon.title: Lumina Icon
luminaIcon.description: Currency icon applied to each tile price. Leave empty to keep the authored icon.

openEvent.title: Open Event
openEvent.description: App event that opens the shop. Fire it from the dealer dialogue Complete Event.

interactDistance.title: Interact Distance
interactDistance.description: Auto-closes the panel if the player wanders further than this from the dealer.

button.title: Button
button.description: Clickable entity. Defaults to the entity this script is on.

toggleKey.title: Toggle Key
toggleKey.description: Single character that summons and dismisses the car.

spawnDistance.title: Spawn Distance
spawnDistance.description: How far in front of the player the car appears. 0 puts it right where they stand, which is where it belongs since they are seated immediately.

spawnHeight.title: Spawn Height
spawnHeight.description: Extra height at spawn. carController ground-snaps down from here.

parkedCar.title: Parked Car
parkedCar.description: The car standing in the world (the intro CarX). Kept as the body the player has equipped, and hidden while they are driving.

toggleButton.title: Toggle Button
toggleButton.description: HUD button that opens and closes the journal.

toggleKey.title: Toggle Key
toggleKey.description: Single character that toggles the journal. Empty disables the shortcut.

serverRewards.title: Server Rewards
serverRewards.description: Send claims to the server. Leave off until lumatopia.js handles claimAchievementReward.

claimedOpacity.title: Reward Claimed Opacity
claimedOpacity.description: How far the reward pill fades once its tier is claimed. 1 keeps it solid.

keepVisibleUi.title: Keep Visible
keepVisibleUi.description: Screens that stay up while the journal is open, such as the HUD. Every other screen is hidden and put back on close.

luminaTarget.title: Lumina Target
luminaTarget.description: HUD Lumina icon that claimed Lumina fly into. Leave empty to skip the effect.

luminaFlightTime.title: Lumina Flight Time
luminaFlightTime.description: Seconds one Lumina takes to reach the HUD icon.

luminaBurstCount.title: Lumina Burst Count
luminaBurstCount.description: How many Lumina icons fly to the HUD on a claim. Purely visual - the payout is whatever the tier awards, and bigger tiers add a few more on top.

analyticsEnabled.title: Analytics Enabled
analyticsEnabled.description: Master kill switch. When off, no measure() call reaches the Poki SDK.

debugLog.title: Debug Log
debugLog.description: Print every event to the console as "[poki] category / what / action".

pauseOnBlur.title: Pause On Window Blur
pauseOnBlur.description: Also stop gameplay on window blur. Off by default because Poki ad iframes steal focus.

maxDistinctEvents.title: Max Distinct Events
maxDistinctEvents.description: Safety cap. If a high-cardinality value leaks into an event key, drop the overflow and warn.

playtimeMarksMinutes.title: Playtime Marks (minutes)
playtimeMarksMinutes.description: Comma separated minute marks that emit milestone/playtime-Nm/reached.

button.title: Button
button.description: Clickable entity. Defaults to the entity this script is on.

teleportKey.title: Teleport Key
teleportKey.description: Single character that teleports the player home. The keycap art under this button spells it out, so change both together.

standDistance.title: Stand Distance
standDistance.description: How far clear of the home's outer wall the player lands, in metres, level with the doorway. Must stay above zero: landing inside the room counts as walking in and auto-places carried furniture.

spawnHeight.title: Spawn Height
spawnHeight.description: Height above the base to arrive at. A small lift keeps the capsule from starting inside the ground or a doorstep; gravity settles the rest.

cooldownSeconds.title: Cooldown
cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum gap between teleports. Stops a held key or a double tap from firing the arrival repeatedly.

hideUntilTutorialTeaches.title: Hide Until Tutorial Teaches It
hideUntilTutorialTeaches.description: Keep the button out of the way until the tutorial introduces it, which it does right after the first chest is opened by setting app.tutorialTeleportRevealed. Before that there is no furniture to carry home, so there is nothing for it to do. Players who have already finished the tutorial always see it.

black.title: Black
black.description: The half-screen dimmer. Starts over the look side and flips to the joystick side once the player has moved. Falls back to a child named Black.

moveHand.title: Move Hand
moveHand.description: Hand shown over the joystick during step one. Falls back to a child named TutorialHand.

moveText.title: Move Text
moveText.description: Label for step one. Falls back to a child named Text.

lookHand.title: Look Hand
lookHand.description: Hand shown over the look side during step two. Falls back to a child named TutorialHand2.

lookText.title: Look Text
lookText.description: Label for step two. Falls back to a child named Text2.

movedAnchor.title: Moved Anchor
movedAnchor.description: Anchor the dimmer takes once the player has moved, which is what swaps the shaded half of the screen from the look side to the joystick side.

figureAmplitudeX.title: Figure Width
figureAmplitudeX.description: Half the width of the figure-eight the hand traces, in UI pixels. The full sweep is twice this.

figureAmplitudeY.title: Figure Height
figureAmplitudeY.description: Half the height of the figure-eight. Keep it below the width or the eight reads as a circle.

figureSeconds.title: Figure Duration
figureSeconds.description: Seconds for one full loop of the figure-eight.

moveDistance.title: Move Distance
moveDistance.description: How far the player must actually travel, in metres, for step one to count. Pushing the stick into a wall does not finish the step on distance alone, but touching the stick does.

lookDegrees.title: Look Degrees
lookDegrees.description: How far the camera yaw must swing for step two to count. On a phone the look side is the only way to turn it, so this is what "dragged the right half" amounts to.

storageKey.title: Storage Key
storageKey.description: localStorage key that records this tutorial as seen, so it never runs a second time on the same device.

lookDragPixels.title: Look Drag
lookDragPixels.description: A drag this long (screen pixels) that starts on the look side also finishes step two, however far the camera turned.

hideGameUi.title: Hide Game UI
hideGameUi.description: Hide GameUI (the buttons and counters) while the two steps are on screen, so only the joystick, the look side and the hands are there to read. It comes back the moment the tutorial is done.

screen.title: Settings Screen
screen.description: Root/SettingsUI. Toggled to show or hide the whole thing.

blackout.title: Blackout
blackout.description: Full screen dimmer behind the panel. Clicking it closes the settings.

openButton.title: Open Button
openButton.description: The cog in GameUI that opens this panel.

joinButton.title: Join Lobby Button
joinButton.description: Opens the join panel. Not the button that performs the join.

joinCodeField.title: Join Code Field
joinCodeField.description: The box behind the typed code. Clicking it raises the keyboard on mobile.

joinStatusText.title: Join Status Text
joinStatusText.description: The "Enter the Code:" label. Borrowed to report a failed join, then restored.

copyLinkLabel.title: Copy Link Label
copyLinkLabel.description: Text inside the copy button. Flips to "Copied!" briefly.

pokiSignInHint.title: Poki Sign In Hint
pokiSignInHint.description: The brown Poki information panel. Kept visible after sign-in.

pokiSignedButton.title: Poki Signed In Button
pokiSignedButton.description: Shown in place of the Poki sign-in button after authentication.

packRoot.title: Pack Root
packRoot.description: Group holding the pack body and lid. This is what shakes and drops away.

packBody.title: Pack Body
packBody.description: The bag itself (PackBot). Never torn, only shaken and shined.

packLid.title: Pack Lid
packLid.description: The hanger cap (PackTop). Renders the part of the lid still sealed.

peelHinge.title: Peel Hinge
peelHinge.description: Empty group parented above the lid. Script moves it onto the rip front and rotates it.

packLidPeel.title: Pack Lid Peel
packLidPeel.description: Second copy of the lid art, child of Peel Hinge. Renders the torn-away part.

backdrop.title: Backdrop
backdrop.description: Full screen dimmer behind the pack (Blackout).

handHint.title: Hand Hint
handHint.description: Hand that traces the swipe until the player takes over. Hidden once they drag.

itemTemplate.title: Item Template
itemTemplate.description: Disabled image element cloned once per revealed item.

sparkleTemplate.title: Sparkle Template
sparkleTemplate.description: Disabled image element cloned once per sparkle.

itemSprites.title: Item Sprites
itemSprites.description: Icon atlases a random reward is drawn from when the caller supplies no items.

itemCount.title: Item Count
itemCount.description: How many icons rise out of the pack when the caller supplies no items.

itemRowWidth.title: Item Row Width
itemRowWidth.description: Icons are spread across at most this many UI pixels, so a full pack still fits on a phone.

itemRowY.title: Item Row Y
itemRowY.description: Height the revealed icons settle at, in UI pixels from the centre of the screen.

swipeFraction.title: Swipe Distance
swipeFraction.description: Fraction of the canvas width the finger travels for a full tear. Smaller is easier.

openThreshold.title: Open Threshold
openThreshold.description: Tear progress that commits the open when the finger lifts. Below this the lid snaps back.

ripSoftness.title: Rip Softness
ripSoftness.description: Width of the rip front in UV. Wider reads as torn paper, narrower as a clean cut.

ripGlow.title: Rip Glow
ripGlow.description: Light added along the rip front while it travels. Purely additive, it never dims the art.

peelAngle.title: Peel Angle
peelAngle.description: Degrees the torn part of the lid has curled up by the time the tear completes.

peelLift.title: Peel Lift
peelLift.description: UI pixels the rip front rises as the lid comes away.

shineStrength.title: Shine Strength
shineStrength.description: Brightness of the highlight that sweeps the pack while it shakes.

shakeStrength.title: Shake Strength
shakeStrength.description: Peak shake offset in UI pixels.

sparkleCount.title: Sparkle Count
sparkleCount.description: Stars thrown out of the pack mouth on reveal.

hideOtherScreens.title: Hide Other Screens
hideOtherScreens.description: Switch every other screen space UI off while the pack is up, and put it back on close.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Auto Close Seconds
autoCloseSeconds.description: Close by itself this long after the reveal settles. Zero waits for a tap.

openOnStart.title: Open On Start
openOnStart.description: Open the pack as soon as the scene loads. For working on the animation only.

tearSound.title: Tear Sound
tearSound.description: Camera sound slot played when the swipe starts. Skipped when Rip Sound is set.

trailTemplate.title: Trail Template
trailTemplate.description: Disabled image element the swipe trail is drawn out of. Its colour and opacity set how the trail looks.

trailWidth.title: Trail Width
trailWidth.description: Diameter of the head of the trail in UI pixels. Keep it many times Trail Spacing.

trailSpacing.title: Trail Spacing
trailSpacing.description: UI pixels between trail nodes. The ratio of Trail Width to this is what decides whether the stroke reads as a line or as a row of blobs, so keep it under a fifth of the width.

trailSeconds.title: Trail Seconds
trailSeconds.description: How long a node takes to fade out. Longer means a longer trail behind the finger.

trailMaxNodes.title: Trail Max Nodes
trailMaxNodes.description: Hard cap on live trail nodes, so a frantic swipe cannot flood the UI layer.

trailFollowsHint.title: Trail Follows Hint
trailFollowsHint.description: Let the demonstrating hand draw the same trail, so the hint shows the exact stroke that opens the pack.

trailHintOffset.title: Trail Hint Offset
trailHintOffset.description: Offset from the hand sprite centre to its fingertip, where the hint trail is drawn from.

celebrationLayer.title: Celebration Layer
celebrationLayer.description: Optional centred UI group behind Pack Root. Created automatically when unassigned.

shardSprite.title: Shard Sprite
shardSprite.description: OutfitShardsFrame -- the authored puzzle tile per droppable outfit. A shard drop with no frame for it falls back to the plain outfit icon.

ripSound.title: Rip Sound
ripSound.description: PackRip. Scrubbed by the swipe: the clip runs across the whole tear, faster or slower with the finger, and stops when the finger stops.

cooldownSeconds.title: Cooldown Seconds
cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum gap between rewarded breaks, so a double-tap cannot queue two.

packOpening.title: Pack Opening UI
packOpening.description: Entity carrying the packOpening script. Found by search if left empty.

autoOpenGrantedPacks.title: Auto Open Granted Packs
autoOpenGrantedPacks.description: Opens a pack the moment the player owns one. Turn this off once there is a pack button they can press themselves.

autoOpenDelay.title: Auto Open Delay
autoOpenDelay.description: Seconds to let the tutorial celebration clear before the pack takes the screen.

requiredHoldTime.title: Required Hold Time
requiredHoldTime.description: Seconds of holding for the ring to fill, in Full Circle mode.

completeEvent.title: Complete Event
completeEvent.description: App event fired once the ring is full.

radial.title: Interact Radial
radial.description: The InteractRadial widget. Found by name if left empty.

holdSeconds.title: Hold Seconds
holdSeconds.description: How long the player stands in the trigger to fill the ring.

rimColorA.title: Rim Color A
rimColorA.description: Warm end of the iridescent drift.

rimColorB.title: Rim Color B
rimColorB.description: Cool end of the iridescent drift.

rimPower.title: Rim Tightness
rimPower.description: Higher keeps the glow to the very edge of the silhouette.

pulseSpeed.title: Pulse Speed
pulseSpeed.description: Breathing rate of the rim. Slow reads calmer and more valuable.

sweepSpeed.title: Sweep Speed
sweepSpeed.description: Wipes per second. One every couple of seconds catches the eye without nagging.

surfaceOffset.title: Surface Offset
surfaceOffset.description: How far the shell sits off the pack, as a fraction of the model size. Raise it if the rim still flickers, lower it if the glow looks detached.

colorA.title: Color A
colorA.description: Warm end of the drift. Matches the shine shader by default.

size.title: Size
size.description: Radius of the halo, multiplied by the entity scale.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: World-space nudge, for centring the halo on the pack art.

ringSpeed.title: Ring Speed
ringSpeed.description: Rings emitted per second. Slow and deliberate reads as valuable.

radial.title: Interact Radial
radial.description: Shared rewarded-ad radial. Found by name when left empty.

trialSeconds.title: Trial Seconds
trialSeconds.description: How long the rewarded test drive lasts. 300 seconds is five minutes.

previewPriority.title: Preview Priority
previewPriority.description: Unowned cars are offered in this order, then catalog order.

podium.title: Podium
podium.description: Display stand hidden along with the car. Found by name ("Circle") when left empty.

label.title: Label
label.description: Floating caption hidden along with the car. Found by name ("Text") when left empty.

starterCarId.title: Starter Car Id
starterCarId.description: The free car every player already owns. It is never offered as a test drive.

rewardMode.title: Reward
rewardMode.description: Unlock: the ad gives Unlock Car Id for good (the bicycle), the player rides it at once, and the whole display goes away once it is owned.

unlockCarId.title: Unlock Car Id
unlockCarId.description: Unlock mode only: the catalogue id this display gives. The server must mark it adUnlock.

photoUi.title: Photo UI
photoUi.description: The PhotoUI screen. Falls back to the entity named PhotoUI.

birdPositions.title: Bird Positions
birdPositions.description: Parent of the Forest/Summer/Frozen marker groups. Falls back to the entity named Bird Positions.

toggleKey.title: Toggle Key
toggleKey.description: Keyboard key that opens and closes the camera. Testing shortcut.

maxZoom.title: Max Zoom
maxZoom.description: How far the lens magnifies. Past Max Photo Distance, zooming further only makes the bird bigger in frame.

entryDuration.title: Entry Duration
entryDuration.description: Seconds the camera takes to push forward when the camera opens.

entryDolly.title: Entry Dolly
entryDolly.description: How far the camera pushes along its view direction on open. Negative means up to the player, which the camera replaces.

focusDistance.title: Focus Distance
focusDistance.description: Furthest a bird can be and still be photographed without zoom. Zoom stretches it by the zoom factor, up to Max Photo Distance.

maxPhotoDistance.title: Max Photo Distance
maxPhotoDistance.description: Furthest a bird can be photographed at any zoom. Keep it under the server photo reach (30).

spotDistance.title: Spot Distance
spotDistance.description: Birds past photo reach but within this are still framed, labelled "Too Far", and cannot be photographed.

debugFocus.title: Debug Focus
debugFocus.description: Logs to the console, once a second, why each bird in the frame was or was not locked on.

cameraButton.title: Camera Button
cameraButton.description: HUD button that opens photo mode. Falls back to CameraButton under GameUI.

photoWithoutBird.title: Photo Without Bird
photoWithoutBird.description: The shutter takes a picture even with no bird in reach (shown without a name or stars). For a scene without birds, such as the dance beach.

roofTag.title: Roof Tag
roofTag.description: Direct children of a HomeBase with this tag are its roofs. One is shown at a time; Roof_<name> slots in the Roofs list pick them by entity name.

defaultRoof.title: Default Roof
defaultRoof.description: Entity name of the roof a home has until its owner picks another.

maxPhysicsSubSteps.title: Max Physics Sub-steps
maxPhysicsSubSteps.description: Catch-up physics steps allowed per frame. Below 1 / (step x this) FPS the simulation runs slower than real time instead of falling further behind.

slowPhysicsBelowFps.title: Slow Physics Below FPS
slowPhysicsBelowFps.description: When the average frame rate drops under this, physics steps at 30 Hz instead of 60 Hz. 0 disables the switch.

fastPhysicsAboveFps.title: Fast Physics Above FPS
fastPhysicsAboveFps.description: Average frame rate needed to return to 60 Hz physics.

animFullRateDistance.title: Full Rate Distance
animFullRateDistance.description: Animators closer to the camera than this update every frame.

animHalfRateDistance.title: Half Rate Distance
animHalfRateDistance.description: Up to this distance animators update every 2nd frame; beyond it every 4th.

animHiddenPauseDelay.title: Hidden Pause Delay
animHiddenPauseDelay.description: Seconds an animator must be off screen before it is paused.

animExemptTag.title: Exempt Tag
animExemptTag.description: Animators on (or under) an entity with this tag always update every frame.

rebatchLateMeshes.title: Re-batch Late Meshes
rebatchLateMeshes.description: Rebuild a batch group when models that loaded after start-up are left unmerged.

routesRoot.title: Routes Root
routesRoot.description: Parent of the route entities. Defaults to this entity.

starTexture.title: Glow Texture
starTexture.description: Soft halo and rays, greyscale. Drawn with screen blending, so it only ever lightens.

coreTexture.title: Core Texture
coreTexture.description: Small solid star in the middle (colour + alpha). Keeps the stars visible on snow.

spacing.title: Spacing (m)
spacing.description: Average distance along the route between stars. Stars stay where they are on the route; only the stretch ahead of the player is lit.

creepSpeed.title: Creep Speed (m/s)
creepSpeed.description: Very slow drift of the stars toward the target. 0 keeps them still.

starSize.title: Star Size (m)
starSize.description: Typical star; a few grow up to about twice this.

sideScatter.title: Side Scatter (m)
sideScatter.description: Half-width of the band of stars around the route.

drift.title: Drift (m)
drift.description: How far each star gently wanders around its spot.

windEnabled.title: Wind Wisps
windEnabled.description: Thin soft white streaks weaving through the stars, gusting toward the target.

windWave.title: Wind Weave (m)
windWave.description: How far the wisps swing across the path.

windStreakSpacing.title: Wind Streak Spacing (m)
windStreakSpacing.description: Distance between gusts; each streak is roughly a third of this.

windSpeed.title: Wind Speed (m/s)
windSpeed.description: How fast the gusts travel toward the target.

fadeOutTime.title: Fade Out (s)
fadeOutTime.description: How long a star takes to fade once the player has passed it.

startOffset.title: Start Offset (m)
startOffset.description: Stars closer to the player than this start fading out.

arriveDistance.title: Arrive Distance (m)
arriveDistance.description: Trail fades out when the player is this close to the target.

maxAttachDistance.title: Max Road Distance (m)
maxAttachDistance.description: Farther than this from every road, the trail runs straight to the target.

followGround.title: Follow Ground
followGround.description: Raycast down so stars hug terrain and bridges.

owners.title: Guide Owners
owners.description: GuideTrail owners the marker points at. The furniture line is left out on purpose.

heightOffset.title: Height Above Target
heightOffset.description: How far above the target position the dot floats, in metres.

edgeMargin.title: Side Margin
edgeMargin.description: Keeps the circle clear of the HUD button columns, with a gap.

topMargin.title: Top Margin
topMargin.description: Keeps the marker (and an up arrow) under the HUD counters.

bottomMargin.title: Bottom Margin
bottomMargin.description: Keeps the marker and its distance above the chat button and mobile controls.

arrowDistance.title: Arrow Distance
arrowDistance.description: How far from the dot centre the arrow sits, in screen units.

inViewScale.title: In-View Size
inViewScale.description: Size of the circle while the target is on screen, as a share of its full size at the screen edge.

enabledInGame.title: Quests On
enabledInGame.description: Off: no tracker, no guide, and nothing is locked.

trackerGap.title: Quest Tracker Gap
trackerGap.description: Space between the labels of the top-left buttons and the quest tracker under them, in screen units at desktop size.

topRow.title: Top Row
topRow.description: TopRightGroup: the row of icons at the top right.

counters.title: Counters
counters.description: CountersGroup: the money and Lumina chips, under the top row.

chips.title: Chips
chips.description: MoneyChip and LuminaChip. Each is sized to its icon and number.

minTouchPx.title: Icon Box On Phones (px)
minTouchPx.description: On touch phones the HUD groups grow until each 60-unit icon box is this many CSS pixels (the art fills about 85% of it). Narrow phones may get a little less, so the top row stays clear of Poki's pill.

countersGap.title: Chips Below Top
countersGap.description: How far below the top of the screen the chips start, in screen units at desktop size (the row and its labels sit above).

pillSpacer.title: Pill Spacer
pillSpacer.description: The mobileOnly spacer at the start of TopLeft. Sized here to clear Poki's pill.

moneyCounter.title: Money Counter
moneyCounter.description: The HUD money chip (MoneyChip). Its number flashes red.

luminaCounter.title: Lumina Counter
luminaCounter.description: The HUD Lumina chip (LuminaChip). Its number flashes red.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: How far the counter swings to each side at the start, in screen units.

flashColor.title: Flash Colour
flashColor.description: Colour the number flashes while it shakes.

phoneButton.title: Phone Button
phoneButton.description: GameUI/TopRightGroup/PhoneButton. Its Notification shows how many apps want attention.

appsRoot.title: App Buttons
appsRoot.description: GameUI/PhoneApps: the old HUD buttons the apps open. Keep it disabled.

openSounds.title: Pull Out Sounds
openSounds.description: Phone1, Phone2. One is picked at random each time the phone comes out.

buttonSound.title: Button Sound
buttonSound.description: PhoneButton. Taps inside the phone: apps, the quest widget, back, quest rows.

lockSound.title: Put Away Sound
lockSound.description: PhoneLock. The phone being put away (X, Tab, Esc, a tap off it). Not played when an app opens, which has its own tap sound.

openVolume.title: Pull Out Volume
openVolume.description: Phone1 and Phone2 are mastered louder than the rest of the game, so they play quieter than the other phone sounds.

category.title: Buys
category.description: Inventory category this NPC buys: critters or fish.

feature.title: Quest Lock
feature.description: QuestSystem lock opened by talking to this NPC (critters, fishing). The bubble shows while it is shut, the shop once it is open.

greeting.default: Got any critters for me? I will buy them!
greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: The line said before the shop opens.

intro.title: Shop Line
intro.description: Shown at the top of the shop.

emptyText.default: No critters yet! Catch some and come back.
emptyText.title: Empty Text

bubble.title: Quest Bubble
bubble.description: World-space speech bubble over the name, shown until the player has talked to this NPC.

bubbleBob.title: Bubble Bob
bubbleBob.description: How far the bubble floats up and down, as a fraction of its height.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Server collection this NPC keeps (maple, finn, piper). Empty: a shop without a Collection tab.

rewardArt.title: Reward Picture
rewardArt.description: Picture of the costume on the Collection tab.

collectionIntro.default: Bring me these critters and my Ladybug Costume is yours!
collectionIntro.title: Collection Line

collectionDoneText.default: Thank you! The Ladybug Costume is yours!
collectionDoneText.title: Collection Done Line

collectionEmptyHint.default: Catch the critters on the list and bring them here.
collectionEmptyHint.title: Collection Hint
collectionEmptyHint.description: Shown while the player carries nothing the list needs.

seatName.description: Entities with this name become seats. Lift chairs and the slide keep their own.

seatFacing.description: Which way a seated player faces, in the Seat entity's own axes. The Campside seats face the fire opposite their red arrow.

sitRadius.description: How close (metres, on the ground plane) the player must be to a Seat for the Sit prompt.

sitHeightOffset.description: Moves seated players up or down from the Seat entity, in metres. The Sit pose holds the hips 0.37 m above the feet, so -0.32 rests them on a Seat placed on the sitting surface.

standDistance.description: How far in front of the seat the player stands up.

boardRadius.description: How close to someone else's car the Ride prompt appears.

passengerRaise.description: How much higher than the driver's seat marker the passenger sits, in metres at normal player size. The Driving pose holds the hips 0.9 m above the marker, the Sit pose 0.37 m.

passengerForward.description: How much further forward than the driver's seat marker the passenger sits, in metres at normal player size, so both sit level.

radial.title: Interact Radial
radial.description: Shared rewarded-ad radial. Found by name when left empty.

holdSeconds.title: Hold Seconds
holdSeconds.description: How long the player stands on a pad to fill the ring.

effectRange.title: Coin Effect Range
effectRange.description: Auto-collected coins fly from the mailbox only when the player is this close to it (metres).

interactRadius.title: Interact Radius
interactRadius.description: How close (metres, on the ground) the player must stand to one of their own shelves for the Shelf prompt.

itemHeight.title: Item Height
itemHeight.description: Tallest a prop on a shelf stands, in metres.

itemWidth.title: Item Width
itemWidth.description: Widest a prop on a shelf may be, in metres (a shelf spot is about 0.3 m).

touchRadius.title: Touch Radius
touchRadius.description: How close (metres, along the ground) the local player has to come to the sign to open the invite.

touchHeight.title: Touch Height
touchHeight.description: How far above or below the sign the player can be and still touch it.

cooldown.title: Cooldown (s)
cooldown.description: The invite opens again only after the player has stepped away and back, and at least this long after the last time.

fallbackUrl.title: Fallback URL
fallbackUrl.description: Only used if the Settings script cannot be found; normally its Discord Invite URL is opened.

refDistance.title: Full Volume Within
refDistance.description: Metres from the car within which the horn plays at full volume.

maxDistance.title: Heard Up To
maxDistance.description: Metres from the car beyond which the horn is not heard.

cooldown.title: Cooldown (s)
cooldown.description: Time between honks. The server relays at most one honk per player every 0.4 s.

beepGap.title: Beep Gap (s)
beepGap.description: Time from the start of one beep to the start of the next.

template.title: Pack Template
template.description: The authored ShardPack3D. Hidden; copies of it are put down. Found by name if empty.

pickupRadius.title: Pickup Radius
pickupRadius.description: How close (metres, along the ground) the player has to come to pick a pack up.

starterMaxRise.title: Starter Max Rise
starterMaxRise.description: Starter packs lie no more than this many metres above or below the player, so no climb is needed.

photoCircle.title: Photo Spot Ring
photoCircle.description: Root/Circle_PhotoSpot, the ring on the ground.

spotRadius.title: Spot Radius
spotRadius.description: Metres from the ring centre that count as standing on the spot.

tabHands.title: Tab Hands
tabHands.description: QuestHand under WallsTab, FloorTab and RoofsTab, in that order.

board.title: Board
board.description: Which weekly ranking this board shows.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Parent of the rows. Its first child is the row template, cloned for every rank shown.

youLine.title: You Line
youLine.description: Text with the player's own place.

emptyLine.title: Empty Line
emptyLine.description: Shown while nobody is on the board yet.

rowSpacing.title: Row Spacing
rowSpacing.description: Distance between rows, in board units.

columnSpacing.title: Column Spacing
columnSpacing.description: Distance between columns, in board units.

nameLength.title: Name Length
nameLength.description: Longer names are cut to this many letters. Below that, a long name shrinks its letters (the Name text's Auto Fit Width) to fit.

nameGap.title: Name Gap
nameGap.description: Space kept between the name and the score, in board units.

interactRadius.title: Interact Radius
interactRadius.description: How close (metres, on the ground) the player must stand to a mess for its prompt.

coinCount.title: Coins Per Mess
coinCount.description: Coins that fly to the player when a cleaned mess pays out. Only the look: the server sets the amount.

brightness.title: Mess Brightness
brightness.description: The messes are unlit so they read the same in every home; this scales their colour.

serverWaitSeconds.title: Server Wait (s)
serverWaitSeconds.description: Seconds after joining to wait for fixup:ready. A server that never sends it is an older one: brand-new players then still get the fix-up, without coins.

dirtyTint.title: Dirty Tint
dirtyTint.description: Brightness of the dusty floor and faded wallpaper while the home is messy (1 = the textures as drawn).

floorTiling.title: Dirty Floor Tiling
floorTiling.description: How often the dusty plank texture repeats on the floor (the Wood finish uses 1, the other floors 0.25).

wallTiling.title: Dirty Wall Tiling
wallTiling.description: Repeat of the faded wallpaper (the other wallpapers use 0.25, 0.74).

nailHits.title: Hammer Hits
nailHits.description: Hammer blows it takes to fix the broken floor.

sweepStrokes.title: Broom Strokes
sweepStrokes.description: Broom strokes it takes to sweep up a dust bunny.

particleAmount.title: Particle Amount
particleAmount.description: Scales the dust the broom kicks up and the wood chips and dust each hammer blow sends flying (0 = none).

markerSize.title: Marker Size
markerSize.description: Height (m) of the broom or hammer floating over each mess to show where to go and what to do (0 = no markers).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Where a ring starts when play() is given no position. Empty: the local player.

maxRadius.title: Max Radius
maxRadius.description: Used when play() is not given one. The fix-up passes the size of the home.

gloom.title: Gloom
gloom.description: How grey and dim everything the ring has not reached yet looks; the ring lifts it as it passes (0 = off).

closedTemplate.title: Closed Box
closedTemplate.description: Root/JackBoxClosed: the waiting box. Hidden; copied. Found by name if empty.

openTemplate.title: Open Box
openTemplate.description: Root/JackBoxOpen with its Jack child. Hidden; copied. Found by name if empty.

jackRise.title: Jack Rise
jackRise.description: How far (box units) Jack springs up out of the box when it opens.

boxScale.title: Box Scale
boxScale.description: Size of the boxes in the world, times the authored size.

triggerRadius.title: Start Radius
triggerRadius.description: How close (metres, along the ground) the player comes to the waiting box to start.

catchRadius.title: Touch Radius
catchRadius.description: How close counts as touching a box in the round.

triangleRadius.title: Triangle Radius
triangleRadius.description: How far the three boxes jump out from the middle.

roundSeconds.title: Round Time
roundSeconds.description: Seconds before he gets bored and laughs anyway.

openSeconds.title: Open Time
openSeconds.description: How long a box first stays open. Each opening is a little shorter.

warnSeconds.title: Rattle Time
warnSeconds.description: A box rattles this long before it opens.

fakeChance.title: Fake-out Chance
fakeChance.description: How often a rattle is a bait: he only peeks, or pops up and slams back down before anyone can reach him. The first reveal of a round is always a bait.

starterSpot.title: Starter Spot
starterSpot.description: Where a new player's first box waits (Root/JackBoxStarterSpot, beside Gigglesnort). Move it to move the box. Found by name if empty.

shardTemplate.title: Shard Pack
shardTemplate.description: The 3D shard pack thrown to the player when a catch brings one (Root/ShardPack3D). Found by name if empty.

maxBaits.title: Baits In A Row
maxBaits.description: Longest run of baits before he really comes out. Each run gets a random length from 1 to this, so it cannot be counted.

timerUi.title: Timer
timerUi.description: GameUI/JackBoxTimer: the seconds left in a round (its Seconds text). Found by name if empty.

tipImage.title: Tip Picture
tipImage.description: Screenshot for the tip shown after a player's first lost round: someone catching a jester who is fully out. Plain PNG (no basis), so the HTML panel can show it.

slowFps.title: Slow FPS
slowFps.description: Average frames per second under which the "running slow" tip shows after a heavier setting.

watchSeconds.title: Watch Seconds
watchSeconds.description: How long the frame rate is watched (menus closed) after a heavier setting.

groups.title: Prompt Groups
groups.description: GameUI children whose "Key" keycap taps while shown.

learnedAfter.title: Learned After
learnedAfter.description: Presses of a shown keycap's key before the hint stops for good.

peak.title: Peak Scale
peak.description: How big the keycap gets at the top of a beat.

hudButton.title: HUD Button
hudButton.description: GameUI/TopRightGroup/VampireVaultButton. Hidden until the server says the vault has a piece left for this player.

burstEvery.title: Burst Every (s)
burstEvery.description: How often the HUD button does its bigger "look at me" pop. Between bursts it only moves gently.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How far the cursor travels in one second at full tilt, in screen heights.

atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.description: The bat, glint and glow sheet (VampireAura.png). Not preloaded: it is fetched when the first vampire piece is worn.

maxBats.title: Max Bats
maxBats.description: One bat per vampire piece worn, up to this many. 0 switches the effect off.

batSize.title: Bat Size
batSize.description: Wingspan, as a share of the character's height from feet to head.

batColor.title: Bat Color
batColor.description: The one colour every bat is drawn in.

orbitRadius.title: Orbit Radius
orbitRadius.description: How far out the bats fly, as a share of the character's height.

flightSpeed.title: Flight Speed
flightSpeed.description: Multiplies how fast the bats circle.

glints.title: Glints
glints.description: Glints each bat sheds per second (half as many again on the full outfit).

glow.title: Glow
glow.description: Strength of the soft light behind each bat (it is what keeps a dark bat visible against a dark place).

maxDistance.title: Max Distance
maxDistance.description: Wearers farther than this from the camera show no bats.

bats.title: Bats
bats.description: Bats round the display, one per vampire piece it wears (VampireAura.js on Root).

opensVault.title: Opens Vault
opensVault.description: Walking into this entity's collision opens the Vampire Vault.

arrow.title: Arrow
arrow.description: The part that is moved and turned (its Image lies flat, tip along +Z). Defaults to the child named Arrow.

earlyQuests.title: Early Quests
earlyQuests.description: Quest ids (comma separated) that still get the arrow once the tutorial is over.

lead.title: Lead (m)
lead.description: How far ahead of the player, along the route, the arrow lies.

aimAhead.title: Aim Ahead (m)
aimAhead.description: The arrow points at the route this far beyond itself, so it turns before a corner.

hideWithin.title: Hide Within (m)
hideWithin.description: Gone when the goal is closer than this along the route; the goal's own marker takes over.

nudge.title: Nudge (m)
nudge.description: How far the arrow glides forward each beat.

trailSeconds.title: Trail Seconds
trailSeconds.description: How long the trail to a chest stays without the player opening one.

shell.title: Upper Floor
shell.description: Root/HomeUpperFloor: one upper floor of the house, off. Copied for every floor a home has above the ground floor.

circleRadius.title: Circle Radius
circleRadius.description: How close (m, along the ground) the player comes to the circle to be asked.

cooldown.title: Cooldown (s)
cooldown.description: The panel opens again only after the player has stepped out and back, and at least this long after the last time.

dropHeight.title: Drop Height (m)
dropHeight.description: A newly bought floor falls from this high into place.

slotName.title: Sound Slot
slotName.description: Sound slot on the Camera entity played for a press.

songBpm.name: songBpm
songBpm.description: Song tempo, when the song isn't in the songs table.

firstBeat.name: firstBeat
firstBeat.description: Time in seconds of count "1" (first downbeat) in the song, when it isn't in the songs table.

homeStrength.name: homeStrength
homeStrength.description: Fraction of the drift away from the home spot removed per move (0..1).

maxYaw.name: maxYaw
maxYaw.description: Preferred maximum facing angle away from the camera, degrees.

simulateWithoutAudio.name: simulateWithoutAudio
simulateWithoutAudio.description: Run the dance on a fake clock while audio is blocked (testing only).

debugLog.name: debugLog
debugLog.description: Log the clock / animation state every 2 seconds.

latencyMs.name: latencyMs
latencyMs.description: Extra audio latency to compensate (ms, on top of the device's reported output latency).

reactionClips.name: reactionClips
reactionClips.description: Reaction clips the game can trigger with react(name): comma-separated animation names (`<name>.glb` assets, one bar long).

randomize.name: randomize
randomize.description: New opening move and routine on every play; off = the same routine every time for this seed.

idleClip.name: idleClip
idleClip.description: Groove played on the spot before the song and in its count-in (`<name>.glb` animation asset, one bar, looped on the beat; empty = hold the first pose).

song.name: song
song.description:
Song to dance to (audio asset name). Leave the sound slot's asset EMPTY in the editor - a slot asset loads with
the app; this one downloads in the background once the dancer is on screen, then goes into the slot. Empty =
the song of another dancer (so it only needs setting on one).

songsJson.name: songsJson
songsJson.description:
Per-song timing table (json asset), keyed by the song's audio asset name:
{ "<song>": { "bpm": 115, "firstBeat": 0.03, "startBar": 3 } }. A listed song sets songBpm and firstBeat on
every dancer, and the rhythm game's startBar; a song that isn't listed uses the values below.

tapToStart.name: tapToStart
tapToStart.description: Any tap, click or key starts the song ("Tap to dance", for test scenes); off = only start() does (the game flow).

loopSong.name: loopSong
loopSong.description: Play the song again from the top when it ends; off = the dance stops there and 'dance:songEnd' fires.

directorEntity.name: directorEntity
directorEntity.description: Entity that has the danceDirector script (with backup dancers of the same name, the front-most one).

roundBars.name: roundBars
roundBars.description: Bars per round (easy); the beat button is due on the last beat of the round.

startBar.name: startBar
startBar.description: Bar of the song the first round starts on (bar 0 = first downbeat). A song's `startBar` in the songs table (the director's songsJson) overrides it.

roundsPerLevel.name: roundsPerLevel
roundsPerLevel.description: Rounds before the arrow count goes up by one.

perfectMs.name: perfectMs
perfectMs.description: Timing windows, ms either side of the beat; the beat target on the bar is drawn from them.

badMs.name: badMs
badMs.description: Past this a press is a MISS (easy; see hardBadMs); the target fades to clear just beyond it.

seed.name: seed
seed.description: Seed for the arrow sequences (same seed = same rounds for every player).

autoPlay.name: autoPlay
autoPlay.description: Bot plays every round (testing / attract mode).

targetAt.name: targetAt
targetAt.description: Where the beat target sits along the timing bar (0..1); the paw reaches it on the last beat.

songTitle.name: songTitle
songTitle.description: Song name shown top left; empty = the song asset's file name.

spriteBaseUrl.name: spriteBaseUrl
spriteBaseUrl.description: Load the UI sprites from this url folder instead of the project's texture assets (local testing).

failClip.name: failClip
failClip.description: Reaction the dancer plays the moment you MISS, cutting her current move (empty = none).

sfxVolume.name: sfxVolume
sfxVolume.description: Volume of all game sounds (beat hit, riser, miss, crowd, arrow blips).

riserSeconds.name: riserSeconds
riserSeconds.description: Seconds of build-up the riser plays into the beat, once the arrows are typed.

musicDuck.name: musicDuck
musicDuck.description: How far the song dips for a moment under each hit and miss so they cut through (0.4 = 40%, 0 = never).

perfectCheers.name: perfectCheers
perfectCheers.description: Crowd sounds for a PERFECT, one picked at random each time (audio asset names, comma-separated; empty = none).

greatCheers.name: greatCheers
greatCheers.description: Crowd sounds for a GREAT (audio asset names, comma-separated; empty = none).

cheerVolume.name: cheerVolume
cheerVolume.description: Volume of the crowd sounds, relative to the other game sounds (they ring for ~3 s, over the full song).

randomize.name: randomize
randomize.description: New arrow patterns on every play of the song; off = the same rounds every time for this seed.

arrowSound.name: arrowSound
arrowSound.description: Played on every correct direction press (audio asset name; empty = the synth tick).

arrowVolume.name: arrowVolume
arrowVolume.description: Volume of the direction press sound, relative to the other game sounds.

arrowPitchUp.name: arrowPitchUp
arrowPitchUp.description: Each correct press in a sequence plays the arrow sound a step higher (a rising arpeggio).

restPass.name: restPass
restPass.description: After each round the paw makes one more pass with no arrows (a breather); off = rounds back to back.

previewBeats.name: previewBeats
previewBeats.description: Beats before the end of the empty pass that the next round's arrows appear (they can be typed from then on).

beatOffset.name: beatOffset
beatOffset.description: Shifts every round along the song, in beats (+ = later). At 1 the beat press lands on the downbeat (the "1") that ends each pass; at 0 on the pass's own last beat (the "4").

failGroove.name: failGroove
failGroove.description: After a BAD or MISS the dancer stops dancing and only sways on the spot (her idle groove) until the next good beat (COOL or better).

grooveUntilFirstHit.name: grooveUntilFirstHit
grooveUntilFirstHit.description: The dancer only sways (her idle groove) from the start of the song until the first good beat, then starts dancing.

difficulty.name: difficulty
difficulty.description: "easy" or "hard" (a ?difficulty=hard launch URL overrides it). Easy uses roundBars and badMs; hard uses hardRoundBars and hardBadMs; the other timing windows are shared.

hardRoundBars.name: hardRoundBars
hardRoundBars.description: Bars per round on hard (1 = the paw runs twice as fast as easy's 2, so twice as many rounds).

hardBadMs.name: hardBadMs
hardBadMs.description: Past this a press is a MISS, on hard (the faster bar needs a tighter window, or the target band covers most of it).

startOnKey.name: startOnKey
startOnKey.description: A key press starts the dancer's song if it hasn't started (test scenes); off = the game flow starts it.

mode.name: mode
mode.description: 'tap' (notes to hit as their rings close) or 'bar' (the arrows, then the beat); a ?mode=bar launch URL overrides it.

tapVolume.name: tapVolume
tapVolume.description: Volume of the tap mode's hit (a soft closed hi-hat, "tss"); 1 is subtle, well under the song.

firstCutBar.name: firstCutBar
firstCutBar.description: First bar a shot may change on (the first rhythm round).

cutUnitBars.name: cutUnitBars
cutUnitBars.description: Shots change only on multiples of this many bars after firstCutBar (the rhythm round length).

beatKick.name: beatKick
beatKick.description: Zoom pump on every beat, degrees of field of view (0 = off).

perfectPunch.name: perfectPunch
perfectPunch.description: Punch-in on PERFECT, degrees of field of view (half on GREAT).

boundsMin.name: boundsMin
boundsMin.description: Room limits for the camera (world space).

aisleHalfWidth.name: aisleHalfWidth
aisleHalfWidth.description: The desk rows: below deskClearance the camera stays within |x| < aisleHalfWidth between deskZMin and deskZMax.

debugKeys.name: debugKeys
debugKeys.description: Press C to jump to the next shot (testing).

blendSpeed.name: blendSpeed
blendSpeed.description:
Fastest a smooth transition may move the camera, metres per beat; farther moves take longer, and
a move that would need more than 4 beats becomes a hard cut.

bloomThreshold.name: bloomThreshold
bloomThreshold.description: Brightness (linear HDR) above which pixels glow.

focusRange.name: focusRange
focusRange.description: Depth in metres around the focus point that stays sharp.

blurRadius.name: blurRadius
blurRadius.description: Background blur strength, pixels of the quarter-resolution blur.

blurRings.name: blurRings
blurRings.description: Blur quality: rings x points per ring of samples (more = smoother, slower).

focusDistance.name: focusDistance
focusDistance.description: Focus distance when there is no danceCamera and no dancer, metres.

samples.name: samples
samples.description:
