Anti-aliasing samples: 0 = auto (4 on desktop, 1 on mobile, whose high-dpi screens hide jaggies and
where the extra depth pass that MSAA needs for the blur costs too much).

renderScale.name: renderScale
renderScale.description: Render resolution scale (lower = faster on weak devices).

radius.name: radius
radius.description: How far the ring travels, metres.

duration.name: duration
duration.description: Seconds the ring takes to travel out and fade.

roomFlash.name: roomFlash
roomFlash.description: How much the whole room lights up with the hit.

glowFlare.name: glowFlare
glowFlare.description: Extra emission on glowing props at the peak (1 = twice as bright).

bloomKick.name: bloomKick
bloomKick.description: Extra camera bloom at the peak (0.25 = 25% more; much more washes the pastel room out).

comboBoost.name: comboBoost
comboBoost.description: Extra strength per combo step, up to a combo of 10.

targets.name: targets
targets.description: The entities whose materials the ring lights (names, comma-separated, anywhere in the scene); empty = this entity's.

tapStrength.name: tapStrength
tapStrength.description: Strength in the tap mode, where PERFECT comes every beat or two (not once a round): a lighter ring.

fullCombo.name: fullCombo
fullCombo.description: Combo at which the swirl is at full strength.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Orbit radius around the dancer at low combo, metres (it widens with the combo).

height.name: height
height.description: How high the sparkles climb, metres.

maxParticles.name: maxParticles
maxParticles.description: Particles at full strength (read at start); every other one gets a trail.

trailCombo.name: trailCombo
trailCombo.description: Combo at which the line trails start to appear (they are full by about fullCombo - 2).

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Radius to the outside of the rim, metres.

tileGlow.name: tileGlow
tileGlow.description: How much the tiles glow from within.

lightGlow.name: lightGlow
lightGlow.description: Light brightness; above 1 the camera bloom makes them glow.

chase.name: chase
chase.description: Degrees per second the lights chase around the floor.

target.name: target
target.description: Who to follow; empty = the entity with a playerMove script.

sharpness.name: sharpness
sharpness.description: How tightly the camera keeps up (higher = tighter, lower = floatier).

minZoom.name: minZoom
minZoom.description: The nearest zoom, times the editor's distance.

maxZoom.name: maxZoom
maxZoom.description: The furthest zoom, times the editor's distance.

characterName.name: characterName
characterName.description: Child entity with the model (and its anim component).

runSpeed.name: runSpeed
runSpeed.description: Top speed, metres per second; the run clip plays at normal speed here (its feet move at 3.6).

acceleration.name: acceleration
acceleration.description: How quickly she gets up to speed (higher = snappier).

turnSpeed.name: turnSpeed
turnSpeed.description: How quickly she turns to face where she runs (higher = snappier).

camera.name: camera
camera.description: The camera the controls are relative to; empty = the first camera in the scene.

stepHeight.name: stepHeight
stepHeight.description: Highest step she walks up, metres.

maxDrop.name: maxDrop
maxDrop.description: Deepest drop she walks off, metres.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Her width for bumping into walls (radius), metres.

height.name: height
height.description: Walls are felt from stepHeight up to this height above her feet, metres.

water.name: water
water.description: Entities she can't walk on: comma-separated names (and names starting with one plus "_").

touchStick.name: touchStick
touchStick.description: On-screen thumb stick on touch screens.

deceleration.name: deceleration
deceleration.description: How quickly she stops when you let go (higher = snappier).

blendTime.name: blendTime
blendTime.description: Crossfade between idle and run, seconds.

clickToMove.name: clickToMove
clickToMove.description: Click or tap the ground to run there.

markerColor.name: markerColor
markerColor.description: Colour of the marker where you clicked.

stepSound.name: stepSound
stepSound.description: Footstep sound while she runs (audio asset name; empty = none).

runAnimSpeed.name: runAnimSpeed
runAnimSpeed.description: How fast the run clip plays at full speed: 1 = its own pace (its feet keep up with runSpeed), more = quicker steps.

obstacleTag.name: obstacleTag
obstacleTag.description: She shows through entities with this tag (and their children) only.

height.name: height
height.description: Her height, metres: obstacles across the view of her, feet to head, are checked.

streakDrift.name: streakDrift
streakDrift.description: How fast the streaks drift up, streaks per second (0 = still).

camera.name: camera
camera.description: Camera whose depth map the sea reads; empty = the first camera in the scene.

hide.name: hide
hide.description: Entities hidden while playing: the flat colour strips the shader replaces.

seaDepth.name: seaDepth
seaDepth.description: Water depth at which the sea is fully deep blue, metres.

foamWidth.name: foamWidth
foamWidth.description: Width of the foam rim, in metres of water depth.

surfSpeed.name: surfSpeed
surfSpeed.description: How fast the surf lines roll in.

poolDepth.name: poolDepth
poolDepth.description: Distance from the pool wall to its deepest colour, metres.

seaEntities.name: seaEntities
seaEntities.description: Sea entities, picked rather than named (where the name isn't the sea's alone: Lumatopia's islands are all "Water").

tileSize.name: tileSize
tileSize.description: Size of one tile of the texture in the world, metres (across, up).

strength.name: strength
strength.description: How strongly the texture shows: 0 = plain colour, 1 = as made, more = stronger.

wallsOnly.name: wallsOnly
wallsOnly.description: Only on faces that stand upright: walls get it, roofs and tops of the same mesh don't.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: Ball radius, metres; 0 = from the model.

gravity.name: gravity
gravity.description: Gravity, m/s²; lower than real for a floaty, playable ball.

bounce.name: bounce
bounce.description: Bounciness on the ground and walls, 0..1.

friction.name: friction
friction.description: How quickly it stops rolling on the ground (higher = sooner).

kick.name: kick
kick.description: How hard the player knocks it.

targets.name: targets
targets.description: Plants that sway (comma-separated entity names; every entity with the name).

sway.name: sway
sway.description: How far the top of a plant moves, as a fraction of its height.

direction.name: direction
direction.description: Where the wind blows towards, degrees around the up axis (0 = +z, 90 = +x).

happyDistance.name: happyDistance
happyDistance.description: The player this close (metres) makes it happy.

player.name: player
player.description: The player; empty = the entity with playerMove.

hearts.name: hearts
hearts.description: Hearts pop out above its head while it is happy.

heartRate.name: heartRate
heartRate.description: Hearts per second while it is happy.

happyHops.name: happyHops
happyHops.description: How many hops it greets her with.

songs.name: songs
songs.description: Songs offered, in this order (audio asset names, comma-separated); empty = every song in the dancers' songs table.

applause.name: applause
applause.description: Crowd applause at the finish (audio asset name; empty = none).

stages.name: stages
stages.description: The stages a show may be on, one picked at random for each show offline (online the server picks): 'beach' (the beach's own) and the STAGES ids.

dressUp.name: dressUp
dressUp.description: DRESS UP beside DANCE in the hub (off in Lumatopia, where players dress in Lumatopia's own wardrobe).

lookPick.name: lookPick
lookPick.description: A new player's first show lets them pick a look (the presets: Cute or Cool); off where they have one already (Lumatopia).

offlineRewards.name: offlineRewards
offlineRewards.description:
Offline (no server), shows and quests still pay XP, coins and vinyls into this browser's count; off where the wallet
is another game's money (Lumatopia's, which only its server pays).

vote.name: vote
vote.description:
After an online show the group votes for the next song (alone: Retry / Songs); off, CLAIM takes the rewards and
goes back to the beach (Lumatopia's beach: a show is one song).

lumatopiaHud.name: lumatopiaHud
lumatopiaHud.description:
Lumatopia's HUD is on the screen (Lumatopia's beach): its Settings button opens SETTINGS (so no gear here), its money
chip shows the coins (her wallet keeps the vinyls), and her profile corner sits under its top-left buttons.

serverUrl.name: serverUrl
serverUrl.description: Game server (ws:// or wss://); empty = offline. A ?server= url parameter overrides it.

sdkAsset.name: sdkAsset
sdkAsset.description: Script asset with the Colyseus client (colyseus.js, a UMD build that defines window.Colyseus).

sendRate.name: sendRate
sendRate.description: Position updates sent per second while she moves.

smoothing.name: smoothing
smoothing.description: How quickly other players catch up with where they should be (higher = snappier).

tokenKey.name: tokenKey
tokenKey.description:
Where the sign-in token is kept (localStorage): Dancetopia's own, or 'token' in Lumatopia (the account Lumatopia's
room signed in, so the beach is theirs).

sceneName.name: sceneName
sceneName.description: The venue's scene, loaded into the beach when a show is asked for.

music.name: music
music.description: The runway music (an audio asset; 120 BPM, looped).

musicBeat.name: musicBeat
musicBeat.description: Seconds into the music of a beat (its first one), so the walks land on the beat.

keepTheLook.name: keepTheLook
keepTheLook.description: The podium's "Keep the look": BUY for what she wore but doesn't own (off where the game has no shop).

spot.name: spot
spot.description: Where the lead dancer stands (local to this entity); she faces +Z.

boundsMin.name: boundsMin
boundsMin.description: The dance camera's room limits here (local).

aisleHalfWidth.name: aisleHalfWidth
aisleHalfWidth.description: The desk rows (local): below deskClearance the camera keeps within |x| < aisleHalfWidth between deskZMin and deskZMax (0 clearance = no desks).

ambient.name: ambient
ambient.description: The scene's ambient light while dancing here.

backdrop.name: backdrop
backdrop.description: The backdrop: the camera's clear colour (seen through the windows).

toneMapping.name: toneMapping
toneMapping.description: The camera's tone mapping here (0 linear, 1 filmic, 2 hejl, 3 aces, 4 aces2, 5 neutral, 6 none).

bloomIntensity.name: bloomIntensity
bloomIntensity.description: The camera's bloom here: intensity, threshold and blur (its bloom script's).

npcRoot.name: npcRoot
npcRoot.description: Entity whose children (named by NPC id) mark where the NPCs stand.

spotRoot.name: spotRoot
spotRoot.description: Entity whose children (named by spot id) are where find quests' items wait.

ownButton.name: ownButton
ownButton.description: Its MAP button, top right; off where another HUD opens the map (Lumatopia's beach: its Map button calls toggle()).

song.name: song
song.description: The song of the first dance (audio asset name): an easy one, short and not fast.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: How close to the gate's centre (metres, ignoring height) the player walks to go through.

arriveDistance.title: Arrive Distance
arriveDistance.description: Back from the beach, the player lands this far in front of the gate (along its local +Z).

arriveHeight.title: Arrive Height
arriveHeight.description: Height above the ground in front of the gate to land at. A small lift keeps the capsule out of the ground; gravity settles the rest.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: How close to the gate's centre (metres, ignoring height) she walks to go through.

key.title: Key
key.description: The keyboard key that also takes the player back (one letter).

roomName.title: Room
roomName.description: The Lumatopia room the beach joins (the server defines it beside "lumatopia").

glow.name: glow
glow.description: The light along the rim and in the middle.

brightness.name: brightness
brightness.description: Below 1 because the camera's bloom brightens it a lot.

door.name: door
door.description: The door she walks into to open the tower (the portal at its foot).

radius.name: radius
radius.description: How close to the door's centre (metres, ignoring height) she walks to open it.

arriveDistance.name: arriveDistance
arriveDistance.description: Where she's put when a floor's show is over: this far in front of the door (metres).

catalogue.name: catalogue
catalogue.description: The floors: a JSON asset's name (the server's tower.json).

countersGroup.title: Chips
countersGroup.description: GameUI/CountersGroup. The button stands under it, and only shows while it does.

topRow.title: Top Row
topRow.description: GameUI/TopRightGroup. The button lines up under its last icon (Settings) and is as big as it.

phoneButton.title: Phone Button
phoneButton.description: GameUI/TopRightGroup/PhoneButton. Where the button flies to once What's new has been seen.

countersGroup.title: Chips
countersGroup.description: GameUI/CountersGroup. The badge stands under it, and only shows while it does.

topRow.title: Top Row
topRow.description: GameUI/TopRightGroup. The badge lines up under its last icon (Settings) and is as big as it.

camera.name: camera
camera.description: Camera the view rays start from; empty = the scene's Camera.

deepColor.name: deepColor
deepColor.description: Water where the most of it is looked through.

density.name: density
density.description: How quickly the water deepens with the distance looked through, per metre.

minAlpha.name: minAlpha
minAlpha.description: Opacity where the least water is looked through.

maxAlpha.name: maxAlpha
maxAlpha.description: Opacity where the most water is looked through.

fishLength.name: fishLength
fishLength.description: The longest side of each fish, metres at the aquarium's own scale.

door.name: door
door.description: Where she walks in to open the shop (its middle).

display.name: display
display.description: Where the piece on show stands: it faces the door.

radius.name: radius
radius.description: How close to the door's middle (metres, ignoring height) she walks to open it.

featured.name: featured
featured.description: The piece on show before she's looked at any: an item's id (its Lumatopia template's name).

interactRadius.title: Interact Radius
interactRadius.description: How close (metres, on the ground) the player must stand to one of their own tanks for its prompt.

mossHeight.name: mossHeight
mossHeight.description: Height of the moss in the model's space, metres.

critterLength.name: critterLength
critterLength.description: The longest side of each critter, metres at the terrarium's own scale.

flyLow.name: flyLow
flyLow.description: How high fliers drift, metres in the model's space: the lowest and the highest.

showDistance.title: Show Distance
showDistance.description: Names and titles fade in when the player is closer than this to the NPC, in metres (measured flat, ignoring height).

hysteresis.title: Hysteresis
hysteresis.description: They fade out only this much further away, so standing at the edge does not make them flicker.

interactRadius.title: Interact Radius
interactRadius.description: How far (metres, on the ground) from a tree trunk or a rock the player can be for its prompt.

particleAmount.title: Particle Amount
particleAmount.description: Scales the white streaks and the chunks each hit sends flying (0 = none).

serverWaitSeconds.title: Server Wait (s)
serverWaitSeconds.description: Seconds after joining to wait for gather:ready. Without it (an older server, a launch) swings are practice: they look the same, nothing is saved.

woodIcon.title: Wood Icon
woodIcon.description: The pickup toast icon for wood (loaded when the first wood drops).

stoneIcon.title: Stone Icon
stoneIcon.description: The pickup toast icon for stone (loaded when the first stone drops).

woodDrop.title: Wood Drop
woodDrop.description: The log that hops out of a chopped tree and flies into the player (Models/Resources/Wood). Loaded when a tree is in reach.

woodDropMaterial.title: Wood Drop Material
woodDropMaterial.description: The wood drop's material (the empty crate's: the log shares its texture).

stoneDrop.title: Stone Drop
stoneDrop.description: The stone that hops out of a mined rock and flies into the player (Models/Resources/Rock). Loaded when a rock is in reach.

interactRadius.title: Interact Radius
interactRadius.description: How far (metres, on the ground) from the middle of the yellow circle the player can be for its prompt.

woodIcon.title: Wood Icon
woodIcon.description: Wood on the panel and the signboard.

stoneIcon.title: Stone Icon
stoneIcon.description: Stone on the panel and the signboard.

moneyIcon.title: Money Icon
moneyIcon.description: Coins on the panel and the signboard (the HUD's money icon).

sceneName.title: Scene
sceneName.description: The sky scene. Nothing of it loads with the game: it is appended only when someone goes up, and dropped again when they come down.

skyTexture.title: Night Sky
skyTexture.description: The night panorama (equirect, NightSky.jpg): made into the skybox while up there, so it is never cut off by the camera's far clip.

material.title: Material
material.description: The cloud material that gets the rim glow (CloudDunes).

power.title: Rim Tightness
power.description: Higher = only the very edges glow.

flat.title: On Flat Ground
flat.description: How much of the glow flat, up-facing cloud keeps (0 = only the sides of the puffs and towers glow).

minElevation.title: Lowest Star (deg)
minElevation.description: No stars below this angle above the horizon (where the cloud towers are, and the sky glows).

radius.title: Distance (m)
radius.description: How far from the camera the stars are drawn; must stay inside the camera's far clip (400 m).

starSize.title: Star Size (m)
starSize.description: Smallest and largest star, in metres at that distance (about 0.33 m per pixel on a 1080p screen).

moonSize.title: Moon Size (deg)
moonSize.description: How wide the moon looks, in degrees of sky.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Optional. The camera whose depth map the water reads; empty = the game camera.

skyColor.title: Reflection Colour
skyColor.description: What the water mirrors when seen at a low angle.

deepDepth.title: Deep At (m)
deepDepth.description: Water this deep is almost fully the deep colour.

clarity.title: Shallow Opacity
clarity.description: How solid the water is where it is very shallow (0 = clear, the ground shows).

moon.title: Moon Light
moon.description: Directional light the glints come from (MoonLight). Empty = straight above.

foamLine.title: Foam Line (px)
foamLine.description: Width of the foam line where the water meets anything, in screen pixels (0 = no foam).
